verdict.rationale: Deel's global payroll page says it runs compliant payroll for employees, contractors and EOR workers across 150+ countries, which covers both the employer-of-record and owned-entity paths. Its MCP tools include an EOR-versus-entity hiring cost comparison, and a community user reports having about 75 people hired through Deel. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on EOR onboarding and owned-entity payroll setup (the evidence is mostly marketing-level), and independent hands-on detail on how the international employment flows work.
